blurb: Tiny, smooth-coated German pinscher with a high-stepping, hackney-like gait
description: The Miniature Pinscher is a small German dog of Pinscher type with a short, smooth coat, a compact build and a vigorous, alert and fearless presence.
answer: The Miniature Pinscher, or Zwergpinscher, is a small German dog of Pinscher type, traditionally used to hunt mice and other vermin. It stands 25–30 cm and weighs 4–6 kg, and is described as vigorous, alert and self-possessed.

body: The Miniature Pinscher was traditionally used to hunt mice, lizards, small birds, rabbits and other vermin. An 1888 drawing by Jean Bungartz compares it with the German Pinscher. The FCI fully accepted the breed in 1955, and genetic research published in 2017 found shared ancestry with the Toy Manchester Terrier. Sources give little further detail on its history.

It is a well-balanced, sturdy, compact, short-coupled dog with straight legs and a characteristic hackney-like action. Both sexes weigh 4–6 kg and stand 25–30 cm. The short, smooth coat has no undercoat and comes in solid red, stag red and black, chocolate, blue or fawn with tan or rust points, although show rules in the US and Germany accept only red, stag red, and black or chocolate with rust points.

The breed standard describes the Miniature Pinscher as vigorous and alert, with fearless animation, complete self-possession and a spirited presence. It is also reported to be prone to separation anxiety.

The breed is described as naturally well groomed, and its short, single coat is generally considered low-maintenance. Sources give little detail on exercise; as a lively former vermin hunter it is usually thought to enjoy regular activity.

A 2024 UK study found a life expectancy of 13.7 years, and a 2024 Italian study found 11 years. Sources name no specific breed conditions; breed clubs generally recommend health screening of breeding stock and regular veterinary check-ups.

faq.q: How big does a Miniature Pinscher get?
faq.a: Both males and females stand 25–30 cm at the withers and weigh 4–6 kg.
They have a short, smooth coat with no undercoat, which is generally considered easy to keep.

faq.q: Is a Miniature Pinscher a small Doberman?
faq.a: No. It is a German Pinscher-type breed; genetic research in 2017 found shared ancestry with the Toy Manchester Terrier.
